policy.objectiveDropRule: A candidate may be dropped here only when its required dataset is proved unavailable or its minimum experiment is objectively outside the declared resource budget.
policy.noveltyHandling: Attach collision signals and unresolved deltas without eliminating a candidate.
policy.evidenceHandling: Separate confirmed facts, static-code facts, unverified assumptions, and unavailable assets.
policy.selectionAuthority: A fresh jury that did not generate the candidates.

candidates.title: 协同消息突发下的接收端 GPU/PCIe 隔离
candidates.notes: QuantV2X exposes useful offline payload and TensorRT instrumentation hooks, but no fixed official checkpoint or live multi-sender receiver was verified. A controlled offline replay may establish a synthetic systems result; it cannot establish the claimed true online receive-burst behavior.

candidates.title: 同步传感周期触发的协同 incast 与错相发送租约
candidates.notes: Standards and primary systems work verify periodic flows, DCC synchronization, and multi-service queueing, but not the full sensor-phase to receiver-queue to perception-effect chain. CAM must not be presumed synchronized. Keep this as a two-week go/no-go candidate until SEE-V2X traces and staged VaN3Twin instrumentation localize a receiver queue.

candidates.title: 特征、位姿与标定版本的原子快照合同
candidates.notes: OpenCOOD, RCP-Bench, DDS, ROS 2, and CPM expose a reproducible injection and protocol gap, but no public operational trace verifies natural model or calibration epoch tearing. Require a paired coherent-stale versus torn incremental effect under matched component errors before scored review.

candidates.title: 协同感知滚动升级中的 wire capability 协商
CAM/BSM 与协同感知流量共存时的跨服务队列隔离
多车自适应压缩控制器的耦合振荡审计
candidates.notes: The candidate is narrowed to coupled CPS/BME semantic-content and congestion-control dynamics. Artery exposes CPM and LIMERIC at a fixed commit, and a 2026 direct neighbor explicitly leaves convergence and threshold-period interaction open. The two-week claim is protocol-level; perception claims remain conditional on an offline OpenCOOD trace adapter.

candidates.title: V2X 伪名轮换下的感知缓存连续性
稀疏协同特征的加密流量元数据泄漏
PC5/Uu 双路径协同消息的 exactly-once 融合提交
协同消息时钟域溯源与单向 age 可识别性
candidates.notes: The candidate is narrowed to timestamp event and clock-domain provenance plus an identified age interval and honest fresh, stale, or uncertain decision. It explicitly excludes a new synchronization or AoI-compensation model. The two-week closure is CPU-first and does not depend on a perception checkpoint.

candidates.title: 全球一致 ID 对协同预测增益的影响审计
candidates.notes: V2X-Seq constructs cooperative identities through an official IoU, Hungarian, and multi-frame fusion procedure rather than exposing a simple raw global-ID oracle. Actual prevalence and causal online replacement still require an authorized TFD sample.

candidates.title: 协同轨迹预处理的前缀因果性审计
candidates.notes: The fixed code contains retrospective window logic, explicit future reads, and future-conditioned cohort or metadata paths, but no real TFD sample mutation or official checkpoint forward run succeeded. Keep this as a conditional reserve; do not call the static findings benchmark leakage.

candidates.title: 同延迟边际分布下的抖动与乱序关联失效
跨视角接力中的身份存活与预测恢复
密集同向交通中的跨视角 false-friend 压力测试
以跨视角预测分歧驱动协同预测校准
协同预测榜单的可评分对象与缺失机制审计
candidates.notes: The candidate is reframed from a leaderboard missingness audit into a deployable hierarchical risk-coverage policy over cooperative, ego-only, and safe-degraded outputs. The public CooperScene CoSDH config and 111 MB checkpoint are anonymously available with a fixed LFS SHA-256 and bind to the mini test index. One end-to-end run and a second model family or benchmark remain required; V2X-Real has public data but no official checkpoint.

candidates.title: Co-MTP 中 ego future 条件的可部署性审计
candidates.notes: The paper transparently defines AV future ground truth as an input and interpolates it to simulate a planning trajectory. The public CLI, training mode, checkpoint, paths, preprocessing schemas, and licenses contain independent blockers; only a repaired non-oracle contract audit is presently credible.

candidates.title: CoopTrack 跨智能体关联监督的分布迁移
无全局轨迹 ID 的双视角预测记忆
一次发送全历史与因果逐帧到达的等价性检验
candidates.notes: The dataset links are public, but the fixed official repository has no V2XPnP model, trainer, evaluator, configurations, environment, checkpoint, or license. The paper method cannot be faithfully compared with causal per-frame arrivals until a commit-bound implementation is released.

candidates.title: V2XScenes 论文 80/20 协议与发布代码样本重叠审计
candidates.notes: Both official YAML files use identical train and test scenario sets, and the official loader consumes whole selected folders. Data-level path and hash overlap and any attribution to published metrics remain unproved until authorized data and checkpoint provenance are available.

candidates.title: V2X-Seq 序列互斥但地点非互斥的 RSU 与地图记忆审计
V2X-Seq-TFD 滑动场景与多目标视角的伪重复审计
V2X-Seq 协同轨迹预测的预融合轨迹 Oracle 差距
RCooper 固定 RSU 与世界坐标记忆的反事实评测
RCooper 跨协作拓扑与节点数退化曲线
TUMTraf-V2X 隐藏测试集上的条件分层与场景级置信区间
V2V4Real 跨 clip 路线与时间邻接泄漏审计
V2U4Real 城市、校园、乡村 split 与 UAV 姿态捷径审计
V2X-DG 跨数据集域泛化中的传感器与协作拓扑混杂分解
CoopTrack 跨代理关联是否依赖全局身份字段的黑盒与静态审计
协同感知基准的场景级有效样本量与置信区间重估
candidates.notes: CRC-verified released mini indexes contain four ego projections per physical event, including infrastructure agent 0, while every public converter version permits only vehicle egos 1/2/3 and writes different metainfo. The release pickle members predate the first public converter, so their generator remains unknown. The targeted review requires full-release R4/RV3/G3/RI parity and at least one frozen model paired event-level AP result before scored review.

candidates.title: 同一协同场景多 ego 投影造成的伪样本增益审计
candidates.notes: The distributed mini indexes emit four receiver-conditioned rows from one physical event and shared sensor set, including infrastructure ego, while every public converter version emits three vehicle egos. The projections are not byte-identical duplicates. This candidate is merged into the broader release-parity package; ego multiplicity alone is not a contribution and the package remains blocked on full-release and paired-model evidence.

candidates.title: 工作负载不确定性下的 CooperScene 消息完成可识别区间
candidates.notes: A fresh identification reviewer found that the take-9 pilot establishes abstraction sensitivity only. Direct Iperf-to-model workload transfer, payload wire semantics, queue policy, and values for the other 13 takes remain unidentified or incomplete. Keep this as a high-value reserve until all 14 takes, admissible map classes, and endpoint witnesses pass the recorded gates.

candidates.title: CADET 自适应压力搜索后的选择校正安全效应推断
candidates.notes: The official project page currently disables code access and the retained anonymous endpoint did not expose a connected repository. The paper remains primary evidence, but the proposed executable CADET intervention cannot start from the current public snapshot.

candidates.title: 协同自治故障图的最小可识别干预集
candidates.notes: The proposed intervention study requires source-level scenario controls and synchronized logs that are not presently available from a fixed official release.

candidates.title: 任意字节前缀可解码的协同感知消息
candidates.notes: The official CodeFilling tensor path is public, but its EntropyCoder is not initialized and the audited code has no working wire codec. The checkpoint link was not anonymously verifiable. Parser conformance can be developed independently, but an end-to-end CodeFilling result remains blocked.

candidates.title: 从可达集合到精细轨迹的 rateless 协同预测协议
协同推理故障定位的最小因果 span 证书
从协同融合测试导出的运行时语义检查器
candidates.notes: The candidate is narrowed to a cooperative-perception contract IR, cross-asset provenance graph, semantic-preserving metamorphic differentials, and explicit claim boundaries. CooperScene, V2XScenes, Co-MTP, and CodeFilling provide fixed-commit static evidence, but model-impact and wire-byte claims remain conditional on a licensed runnable path and real serialization boundary.

candidates.title: 从消息完成到制动裕度的可组合可靠性预算
candidates.notes: The reliability-contract hypothesis remains meaningful, but the CADET-specific minimum study is not executable until the official source, scenario manifests, checkpoints, and license are published.

candidates.title: 有限标注预算下的 anytime-valid 协同感知风险审计
candidates.notes: The statistical protocol remains executable in principle, but the candidate assumes two pretrained V2X-Real models that are not available in the audited official repository. The documented training entry point is also absent, so a valid study must budget for environment repair and training or switch to fixed public predictions.

candidates.title: 按独立故障域而非车辆数构造协同证据 quorum
candidates.notes: The candidate does not claim a new quorum abstraction. It contributes a cooperative-perception evidence-root manifest, controlled root-cardinality experiment, root-disjoint admission, and provenance-error sensitivity. The two-week causal test is feasible with assigned roots; deployability remains conditional on non-oracle lineage.
